items.title: Book in 60 Seconds
text: Call 647-922-5865 or fill out the form. Tell us the unit size and your address. We offer same day apartment cleanout across the GTA when you book before noon.

items.title: We Arrive On Time
text: Our crew shows up on schedule. We give you a firm upfront price before touching anything. No surprises, no extra charges.

items.title: Gone — All of It
text: We load all items into the truck, sweep up, and leave the unit empty and clean. Landlords and property managers — we know your turnover timelines and work accordingly.

items.q: How much does an apartment cleanout cost?
a: Our service starts from $125. The final price depends on the size of the unit and the volume of items. All prices are confirmed upfront before any work begins. No hidden fees.

items.q: Do you work with landlords and property managers?
a: Yes. We regularly work with landlords, property managers, and real estate agents across the GTA. We understand tight turnover timelines and can work around building access and elevator bookings.

items.q: How fast can you clear the unit?
a: We offer same day apartment cleanout across most of the GTA when you book before 12pm. Call 647-922-5865 or fill out the form to check availability.

Our apartment cleanout service includes removing all items from the unit, loading them into our truck, responsible disposal, and leaving the space broom-clean. All labour is included in the upfront price.

items.q: Do you clear condos and basement suites too?
a: Yes. We clear all types of residential units — studio apartments, 1- and 2-bedroom condos, basement suites, townhouse units, and more. Size does not matter.
Yes. Fully licensed and insured on every job. We are happy to provide proof of coverage on request — property managers often ask for this and we have it ready.
We cover the full GTA including Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Scarborough, North York, Etobicoke, Newmarket, Ajax, Oakville, Burlington and more. Call 647-922-5865 to confirm.
